def transform(A, B):
    if set(A) != set(B):
        return -1
    
    n = len(A)
    m = len(B)
    steps = 0
    
    i = n - 1
    j = m - 1
    
    while i >= 0 and j >= 0:
        if A[i] == B[j]:
            i -= 1
            j -= 1
        else:
            steps += 1
            i -= 1
    
    return steps
